modalLead: Reorder bookmarks by dragging the whole row, collapse every category at once, and create a new page or category right from the add-bookmark form.

items.text: Drag a bookmark anywhere on its row — moving a bookmark within a category or into another one now works by grabbing the row itself, not just the thin strip on the far left. A single click still opens the bookmark, and a long press still opens the inline editor.

No more flicker when dragging between columns — dropping a bookmark into a category in another column used to make the columns jump and flicker until you let go. The drop marker now moves smoothly and the column stays put.

Collapse or expand every category at once — press . anywhere on the dashboard, or use the new toolbar button, to fold all categories away (or open them all back up). Your choice is remembered per page.

Drag categories by the “//” in the title — the // in front of a category name is a drag handle again, so you can reorder whole sections on the dashboard, including across columns. A plain click on it still collapses the category.

Create a new page or category inline — the add-bookmark form's Page and Category dropdowns each have a + New… option. Pick it, type a name, and it's created and saved on the spot — no need to add a bookmark first or leave the form.
